verdict.rationale: Docs provide a first-feature tutorial creating a gate, targeting users, and checking it live via SDK within a browser console (statsig-docs-24), plus a free-tier signup with feature flags included (statsig-docs-17), console-based exposure monitoring and overrides (statsig-docs-19, statsig-docs-29), and community praise confirming Statsig ships fast, developer-friendly tooling (statsig-comm-1, statsig-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent hands-on account of actual time-to-first-flag from signup and no third-party benchmark of onboarding speed.
